53	// BuildBitcoinHeader constructs an 80-byte Bitcoin header from neural data
54	// This is the transient "Camouflage" header generated on-the-fly
55	func (tr *TrainingRecord) BuildBitcoinHeader(nonce uint32) []byte {
56		header := make([]byte, 80)
57		slots := tr.AsicSlots()
58	
59		// Bytes 0-3: Version (Little-Endian)
60		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(header[0:4], BitcoinVersion)
61	
62		// Bytes 4-36: PrevBlockHash from Slots 0-7 (Big-Endian for SHA-256)
63		for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
64			binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(header[4+(i*4):], slots[i])
65		}
66	
67		// Bytes 36-68: MerkleRoot from Slots 8-11 + padding (Big-Endian)
68		for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
69			binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(header[36+(i*4):], slots[i+8])
70		}
71		// Remaining MerkleRoot bytes (12 bytes) padded with zeros
72		for i := 16; i < 20; i++ {
73			header[36+i*4] = 0
74			header[37+i*4] = 0
75			header[38+i*4] = 0
76			header[39+i*4] = 0
77		}
78	
79		// Bytes 68-72: Timestamp (Little-Endian)
80		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(header[68:72], uint32(time.Now().Unix()))
81	
82		// Bytes 72-76: Bits (Little-Endian)
83		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(header[72:76], BitcoinBits)
84	
85		// Bytes 76-80: Nonce (Big-Endian for SHA-256 word alignment)
86		binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(header[76:80], nonce)
87	
88		return header
89	}

93	func (tr *TrainingRecord) BuildHeaderBatch(nonces []uint32) [][]byte {
94		headers := make([][]byte, len(nonces))
95		slots := tr.AsicSlots()
96	
97		// Pre-compute static parts of header
98		staticHeader := make([]byte, 76)
99	
100		// Bytes 0-3: Version (Little-Endian)
101		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(staticHeader[0:4], BitcoinVersion)
102	
103		// Bytes 4-36: PrevBlockHash from Slots 0-7 (Big-Endian)
104		for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
105			binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(staticHeader[4+(i*4):], slots[i])
106		}
107	
108		// Bytes 36-68: MerkleRoot from Slots 8-11 + padding (Big-Endian)
109		for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
110			binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(staticHeader[36+(i*4):], slots[i+8])
111		}
112		// Remaining MerkleRoot bytes (12 bytes) padded with zeros
113		for i := 16; i < 20; i++ {
114			staticHeader[36+i*4] = 0
115			staticHeader[37+i*4] = 0
116			staticHeader[38+i*4] = 0
117			staticHeader[39+i*4] = 0
118		}
119	
120		// Bytes 68-72: Timestamp (Little-Endian) - use same timestamp for batch
121		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(staticHeader[68:72], uint32(time.Now().Unix()))
122	
123		// Bytes 72-76: Bits (Little-Endian)
124		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(staticHeader[72:76], BitcoinBits)
125	
126		// Generate headers with different nonces
127		for i, nonce := range nonces {
128			header := make([]byte, 80)
129			copy(header[:76], staticHeader)
130			binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(header[76:80], nonce)
131			headers[i] = header
132		}
133	
134		return headers
135	}

201	func (sp *SeedPopulation) GenerateCandidateNonces(count int) []uint32 {
202		nonces := make([]uint32, count)
203	
204		// Generate diverse nonces using different strategies
205		quarter := count / 4
206	
207		// Strategy 1: Sequential nonces (deterministic exploration)
208		for i := 0; i < quarter; i++ {
209			nonces[i] = uint32(int(sp.Generation)*1000 + i)
210		}
211	
212		// Strategy 2: Random nonces (stochastic exploration)
213		for i := quarter; i < 2*quarter; i++ {
214			nonces[i] = mathrand.Uint32()
215		}
216	
217		// Strategy 3: Targeted nonces based on current best performers
218		if len(sp.Seeds) > 0 {
219			bestSeedID := sp.getBestSeedID()
220			for i := 2 * quarter; i < 3*quarter; i++ {
221				// Mutate around best performer
222				mutation := uint32(mathrand.Intn(1000) - 500) // +/- 500 range
223				nonces[i] = bestSeedID + mutation
224			}
225		} else {
226			// Fallback to random if no seeds yet
227			for i := 2 * quarter; i < 3*quarter; i++ {
228				nonces[i] = mathrand.Uint32()
229			}
230		}
231	
232		// Strategy 4: Hash-derived nonces (cryptographic exploration)
233		for i := 3 * quarter; i < count; i++ {
234			seed := make([]byte, SeedSize)
235			rand.Read(seed)
236			// Use first 4 bytes of SHA-256 hash of random seed
237			hasher := sha256.New()
238			hasher.Write(seed)

240			nonces[i] = binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(hash[:4])
241		}
242	
243		return nonces
244	}

350	func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) UpdateDifficulty(epoch int) {
351		eh.Epoch = epoch

356		}

358			targetBits = config.MinDifficultyBits
359		}

361		// Create mask using bit-shift (for Big-Endian comparison)
362		var mask uint32
363		if targetBits >= 32 {
364			mask = 0xFFFFFFFF
365		} else if targetBits <= 0 {
366			mask = 0
367		} else {
368			// e.g. 4 bits = 0xF0000000
369			mask = ^uint32(0) << (32 - targetBits)
370		}
371	
372		eh.DifficultyMask = mask
373		fmt.Printf("[DDS] Epoch %d: Difficulty set to %d bits (Mask: 0x%08X)\n", epoch, targetBits, eh.DifficultyMask)

393		xor := goldenNonce ^ uint32(targetToken)

396		// Continuous gradient: even 1 bit match gives some reward
397		// Max reward for matching all targetBits is 0.85

399		if reward == 0 {
400			reward = 0.001 // Tiny base reward to prevent flat advantage

403		// Bonus for passing the threshold (prefix matching)
404		if eh.IsWinningSeed(goldenNonce, uint32(targetToken)) {
405			reward += 0.10
406		}
407

432	// calculateStabilityReward measures convergence behavior across hash passes
433	func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) calculateStabilityReward(seed []byte, sim simulator.HashSimulator) float64 {
434		// Simulate multiple passes to measure stability
435		passes := make([]uint32, 5) // Last 5 passes
436		for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
437			pass := 16 + i // Passes 16-20
438			output, err := sim.SimulateHash(seed, pass)
439			if err != nil {
440				return 0.0
441			}
442			passes[i] = output
443		}
444	
445		// Calculate variance across passes (lower = more stable)
446		var mean uint32
447		for _, pass := range passes {
448			mean += pass
449		}
450		mean /= 5
451	
452		var variance float64
453		for _, pass := range passes {
454			diff := float64(pass) - float64(mean)
455			variance += diff * diff
456		}
457		variance /= 5
458	
459		// Convert variance to stability reward (lower variance = higher reward)
460		// For 32-bit hashes, a "stable" result might still have some variance
461		// Use a very large maxVariance to provide a gradual reward
462		var maxVariance float64 = 0xFFFFFFFF * 0xFFFFFFFF / 12.0
463		stability := 1.0 - (variance / maxVariance)
464		if stability < 0 {
465			stability = 0
466		}
467	
468		return stability
469	}

528	// CalculateBitMatchAdvantage calculates advantage based on bit-match scores (GRPO style)
529	// This provides a gradient for evolution to follow despite SHA-256 avalanche effect
530	func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) CalculateBitMatchAdvantage(results []SeedResult, targetToken int32) []SeedResult {
531		if len(results) == 0 {
532			return results
533		}
534	
535		// Calculate bit-match scores for each result
536		bitScores := make([]float64, len(results))
537		var totalScore float64
538	
539		for i, res := range results {
540			// Use total matching bits (Hamming similarity) for the gradient
541			xor := res.HashOutput ^ uint32(targetToken)
542			matchingBits := 32 - bits.OnesCount32(xor)
543	
544			// Normalize to 0-1 range
545			bitScores[i] = float64(matchingBits) / 32.0
546			totalScore += bitScores[i]
547		}
548	
549		mean := totalScore / float64(len(results))
550	
551		var varianceSum float64
552		for _, score := range bitScores {
553			varianceSum += math.Pow(score-mean, 2)
554		}
555		stdDev := math.Sqrt(varianceSum / float64(len(results)))
556	
557		// Calculate advantage based on bit-match scores
558		for i := range results {
559			if stdDev > 0 {
560				results[i].Advantage = (bitScores[i] - mean) / stdDev
561			} else {
562				results[i].Advantage = 0 // Neutral advantage if no variance
563			}
564	
565			// Boost advantage for seeds that pass the actual difficulty threshold (prefix match)
566			if eh.IsWinningSeed(results[i].HashOutput, uint32(targetToken)) {
567				results[i].Advantage += 2.0
568			}
569		}
570	
571		return results
572	}

603	func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) SelectAndMutate(results []SeedResult, currentSeeds map[uint32][]byte) map[uint32][]byte {
604		sort.Slice(results, func(i, j int) bool {
605			return results[i].Advantage > results[j].Advantage
606		})

608		newGeneration := make(map[uint32][]byte)
609		topCount := int(float64(len(results)) * eh.EliteRatio)
610	
611		// Keep elites and their mutations
612		for i := 0; i < len(results); i++ {
613			seedID := results[i].SeedID
614			if originalSeed, exists := currentSeeds[seedID]; exists {
615				if i < topCount {
616					// 1. Keep the elite itself
617					newGeneration[seedID] = originalSeed
618	
619					// 2. Create a mutation of this elite
620					if len(newGeneration) < eh.PopulationSize {
621						mutatedID := uint32(eh.rand.Intn(1000000))
622						mutatedSeed := eh.BitcoinAwareMutate(originalSeed, results[i].Advantage)

992	func (eh *EvolutionaryHarness) ESWeightedUpdate(
993		results []SeedResult,
994		currentSeeds map[uint32][]byte,
995		step, totalSteps int,
996		initialSigma, minSigma float64,
997		trustRegionDelta float64,

1001		}

1003		// Sort by advantage descending to pick elite parent.
1004		sort.Slice(results, func(i, j int) bool {
1005			return results[i].Advantage > results[j].Advantage
1006		})

1020		}

1046		}

1050			for j := range delta {

1052			}
1053		}

## Audit Results

### Service naming fix
The proto declared `service hasherService` (lowercase), giving it gRPC path `/hasher.v1.hasherService/...` — inconsistent with `HasherTrainingService`. Fixed to `service HasherService` across:
- `internal/proto/hasher/v1/hasher.proto`
- `internal/proto/hasher/v1/hasher_grpc.pb.go` (all invoke paths + `ServiceName` in `HasherService_ServiceDesc`)

### HasherService vs HasherTrainingService — now clearly distinct

| | HasherService | HasherTrainingService |
|---|---|---|
| **Concern** | ASIC compute — hash/batch/mine/verify | Dataset export, training jobs, rule management |
| **Hosted in** | `KNIRVHASHER` (`hasher-server`) | `KNIRVSERVER` (KNIRVHASHER holds only client stubs) |
| **gRPC path** | `/hasher.v1.HasherService/...` | `/hasher.v1.HasherTrainingService/...` |

### Audit document updates (transformer_audit.md)

| Phase | Was | Now |
|---|---|---|
| **Phase 1** (embedder field) | ❌ Missing | ✅ Present at `heart_service.go:26` |
| **Phase 11** (ES Weighted Update + TRPO) | ❌ Not implemented | ✅ Complete — `ESWeightedUpdate()`, `mirroredSample()`, `sigma()`, TRPO clamp all in `evolutionary.go` |
| **Phase 12** (Curriculum Training) | ❌ Not implemented | ✅ Complete — `CurriculumStage`/`CurriculumConfig` in `config/types.go`, `Trainer` in `trainer.go` |

Remaining open gaps (unchanged): Phase 7 (verifier.py wiring), Phase 10 (variance pruning), Phase 13 (entropy gap-queue routing + OntologyDrift), and wiring the curriculum stage into `ESWeightedUpdate`'s step parameter.
